payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methodologies and metrics used to evaluate the quality of the data in the CoVoST dataset.

claims.text: The quality of the data is empirically evaluated using BLEU scores, which measure translation accuracy, and WER/CER for speech recognition accuracy.
Model output variance is assessed by calculating average BLEU scores grouped by transcript and the coefficient of variation to measure stability across different speakers.
Manual inspections of translations and perplexity measurements are conducted to ensure translation quality, along with similarity scores between transcripts and translations.
